title: Stop a running audit and resume from the saved checkpoint
description: Verifies that a long-running audit can be stopped, becomes unblocked, and resumes from the exact saved checkpoint without repeating completed work.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the login field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
Upload valid ISO policy and evidence documents
Start a long-running audit
Stop the running audit
Resume the audit from the saved checkpoint
Verify the audit resumes from the saved checkpoint
Verify completed controls are not reprocessed

title: Stop an active audit and confirm it is unblocked
description: This test verifies that a user can stop an active audit and then see the session transition to a stopped or unblocked state.

steps.description: Navigate to the audit session page for an active audit
Stop the active audit
Open the audit session status view
Verify the session is shown as stopped or unblocked
Verify the session remains available for later management

title: Resume an audit from the latest saved checkpoint
description: This test verifies that a stopped audit can resume from its latest saved checkpoint and continue from the saved progress point.

steps.description: Navigate to a stopped audit session page
Resume the audit from the saved checkpoint
Open the audit session status view
Verify the session shows resumed execution
Verify the saved checkpoint progress is preserved

title: Prevent stopping a session owned by another tenant
description: This test verifies that a tenant cannot stop an audit session belonging to another tenant and that protected session metadata remains inaccessible.

steps.description: Navigate to the audit session page for a session owned by another tenant
Attempt to stop the protected session
Open the audit session status view
Verify access to the protected session is denied
Verify the stop action is not accepted

title: Generate ISO findings from uploaded policy evidence
description: Verifies that a user can upload ISO policy and evidence documents and start an audit that returns generated ISO 27001 findings.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the login field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
Upload valid ISO policy and evidence documents
Start the ISO 27001 audit
Verify ISO 27001 findings are displayed
Verify the audit run is shown as completed

title: Generate VAPT findings with severity and control mapping
description: Verifies that uploaded VAPT scan logs produce technical findings with extracted proof, severity scoring, and control mappings.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the login field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
Upload valid VAPT scan logs and technical evidence
Start the VAPT analysis
Verify VAPT findings are displayed
Verify severity scoring and control mappings are displayed

title: Prevent feedback export without authorization
description: This test verifies that feedback export is blocked when no authorization is present and no feedback data is returned.

steps.description: Navigate to the feedback export view without being authenticated
Request a feedback export
Verify access is denied
Verify no feedback data is returned

title: Import valid feedback and export sanitized records
description: This verifies that a valid feedback import succeeds and the exported feedback contains normalized records with sensitive data redacted.
category: Knowledge Loop Feedback Import & PII Redaction

steps.description: Navigate to /feedback-import
Fill in a valid feedback JSON file with one well-formed record containing email, IP, and phone values
Submit the feedback import
Click the link to export feedback
Verify the exported feedback shows sanitized records
Verify sensitive values are redacted

title: Show checkpoint progress for a running ISO audit
description: Verifies that a multi-control ISO audit exposes checkpoint progress while it is still running.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the login field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
Upload valid ISO policy and evidence documents
Start the ISO 27001 audit
Open the session status view
Verify checkpoint progress is displayed
Verify completed and total control counts are displayed

title: Export auditor feedback as JSON
description: This test verifies that a permitted user can export feedback and receive a valid JSON export containing feedback records or calibration data.

steps.description: Navigate to the feedback export view
Request a feedback export
Verify a JSON export is returned
Verify feedback records or calibration examples are included

title: Redact personal data before feedback is retained
description: This verifies that imported feedback containing emails, IP addresses, and phone numbers is stored only in redacted form for future use.
category: Knowledge Loop Feedback Import & PII Redaction

steps.description: Navigate to /feedback-import
Fill in a valid feedback JSON file containing email, IP, and phone values
Submit the feedback import
Click the link to export feedback
Verify the exported feedback contains redacted personal data
Verify sanitized feedback records are available for reuse

title: Export auditor feedback and import sanitized unique records
description: Verifies that exported feedback can be re-imported with duplicates and PII removed while only unique sanitized records are retained.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the login field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
Open the feedback export view
Export auditor feedback
Import a feedback file containing duplicate records and PII
Verify imported feedback is sanitized
Verify only unique feedback records are retained

title: Reject resuming an audit with no saved checkpoint
description: This test verifies that resuming without checkpoint data is rejected and nothing is resumed for the session.

steps.description: Navigate to an audit session page with no checkpoint data
Attempt to resume the session from checkpoint
Open the audit session status view
Verify the session is not resumed
Verify an error state is shown for missing checkpoint data

title: Prevent duplicate feedback records from being retained
description: This verifies that importing duplicate feedback entries does not create duplicate retained records in the exported feedback.
category: Knowledge Loop Feedback Import & PII Redaction

steps.description: Navigate to /feedback-import
Fill in a feedback JSON file containing duplicate entries for the same feedback
Submit the feedback import
Click the link to export feedback
Verify only unique feedback records are retained
Verify duplicate feedback entries are not present

title: Import feedback with duplicates while preserving a single sanitized record
description: This verifies that duplicate feedback entries are deduplicated and the retained export remains normalized and redacted.
category: Knowledge Loop Feedback Import & PII Redaction

steps.description: Navigate to /feedback-import
Fill in a valid feedback JSON file containing multiple duplicate records and PII
Submit the feedback import
Click the link to export feedback
Verify the exported feedback contains only one retained copy of each record
Verify the retained records are sanitized
